name: Magnify Dock Nav
description: Bottom-docked row of app icons that magnify on hover, with neighboring icons scaling down by distance and a tooltip label rising above the hovered icon.
contents: Row of icon links with labels shown as tooltips
behavior: Hovered icon grows to the hover size, the two neighbors on each side grow to intermediate sizes
Sizes animate with a configurable duration and easing
Tooltip fades and slides up above the hovered icon
editableByProps: Icon sizes, magnify steps, animation timing, dock position and scale
fixed: Dock is fixed to the viewport bottom, centered, above page content (z-index 100)
